_note: MINDTAIL Shorts (branch mindtail). Read by tools/mindtail.mjs, .github/workflows/mindtail.yml and the mindtail-script / mindtail-edit skills. Separate from config/daily.json (the news channel).
brief: MINDTAIL Hindi Short, 9:16 only. SIMPLE edit: about 80% of the runtime is full-frame stock footage (b-roll video clips, plus photos with a slow Ken-Burns move) from Pexels/Pixabay, a cut every 1.5-3 s, literal searches that match each line. Graphics stay light (at most ~20% of the runtime): word-synced Hindi captions (pop, 2-3 words, key words in cyan #00E5FF), a title over the first line at frame 0, and only the odd keyword chip or a number the voice says. No docked/split-screen cards, no busy motion-graphics. Sound is the craft: one CC0 music bed matched to the mood and ducked under the voice, sub-band whoosh on cuts, riser into the reveal, a hit on the payoff, silence before the key line; SFX clearly audible over the bed. No intro, no logo sting, no outro.
topics: relatable youth topics (college, friends, phones, career pressure)

youtube._note: No YouTube upload on this branch until the owner says so. MINDTAIL needs its own YouTube login; the YT_* secrets belong to 24 Hours in Tech.
